integrity: The proof is an exact algebraic reduction of the published CDF, with branch uniqueness proved directly and numerical substitution used only as a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The inversion uses a generalized r-Lambert function rather than elementary functions.
Numerical evaluation of the selected branch is still required unless dedicated software is available.
No universal speed advantage over direct root solving is claimed.
title: Exact r-Lambert quantiles for the FEx-G family
